evidence_level: Independently authored project controls using local Git/Python only; installed-host/provider/model acceptance remains separate.
additional_groups: Two workers concurrently commit distinct owned branches and databases within the same authored repository while its primary HEAD stays unchanged.
A configured effective pre-commit hook opens the original owned database and verifies its attempt owner.
A completed commit with a missing Git-result record reconciles from exact Git intent and saved process identity plus physical quiescence without repeating hooks.
Missing or unverified configured checks and changed plans refuse; checks cannot substitute staged content.
Expired deadline, human hold, missing database and changed hook source after checks prevent committing.
An operation-bound check result cannot borrow another invocation's success.
Stage output is retained in private bounded files before Git gate release, including hook failures and lost replies.
Record two-line and seven-line integer implementations with the same mandatory checks; timing boundaries and sample counts are explicit.
